updates.content:
Title: Some users may be missing the "Meeting options" button for Microsoft Teams meetings in multiple Microsoft 365 apps

User impact: Users may be missing the "Meeting options" button for Microsoft Teams meetings in multiple Microsoft 365 apps.

More info: This issue is occurring in the following Microsoft 365 apps:
- Microsoft Teams desktop client
- Microsoft Teams web client
- Outlook on the web
- Outlook desktop client
 
The issue only occurs in standard Teams meetings, and live events, webinars, and town halls aren’t affected.

Current status: We've received reports from multiple organizations noting that some users are missing the "Meeting options" button for Microsoft Teams meetings in multiple Microsoft 365 apps as listed in the "More info" section of this communication. We've isolated that a tenant filter to disable the "Meetings option" button for a specific group of users was unintentionally applied broadly. We're rolling back the offending change, and we anticipate impact to be remediated by our next scheduled update.

Scope of impact: This issue impacts some users who may be missing the "Meeting options” button when creating standard meetings using multiple Microsoft 365 apps. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Start time: Monday, October 12, 2026, at 8:48 PM UTC

Estimated time to resolve: We anticipate impact to be resolved by our next scheduled update on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC.

Root cause: A tenant filter to disable the "Meeting options" button for a specific organization was unintentionally applied broadly to multiple organizations.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC

Title: Some users may be missing the "Meeting options" button for Microsoft Teams meetings in multiple Microsoft 365 apps

User impact: Users may have been missing the "Meeting options" button for Microsoft Teams meetings in multiple Microsoft 365 apps.

More info: This issue was occurring in the following Microsoft 365 apps:
- Microsoft Teams desktop client
- Microsoft Teams web client
- Outlook on the web
- Outlook desktop client
 
The issue only occurred in standard Teams meetings, and live events, webinars, and town halls weren’t affected.

Final status: We've validated with a subset of affected users that our rollback of the problematic tenant filter has remediated impact.

Scope of impact: This issue impacted some users who may have been missing the "Meeting options” button when creating standard meetings using multiple Microsoft 365 apps.

Start time: Monday, October 12, 2026, at 8:48 PM UTC

End time: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 6:16 PM UTC

Root cause: A tenant filter to disable the "Meeting options" button for a specific organization was unintentionally applied broadly to multiple organizations.

Next steps: 
- We're analyzing the problematic tenant filter to validate why it was applied broadly to further our understanding of how the issue was introduced and to evaluate what actions we can take to prevent similar impact scenarios from occurring in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
